description: A full outage trips the breaker. Each failed half-open probe doubles the open time (exponential backoff, capped at maxResetTimeout), so the recovered backend is only noticed at the next probe.

The backend error rate steps up. Below failureRateThreshold the breaker stays closed and lets the errors through; once the windowed failure rate reaches it the breaker opens, until probes succeed again.
A count-based window of the last 100 calls (~0.2s of traffic) is short enough that every 150ms error spike trips the breaker, rejecting healthy traffic until the next probe.
A 2s time-based window dilutes each 150ms error spike to under 10% failures, so the breaker rides the spikes out and never opens.
